messages:
Maria Gomez: Packaging done for v1.5.0-rc4 — airgap bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-private-releases/v1.5.0-rc4/. Images have been pinned to digests. Need cosign signatures + release-notes signoff before we open the delivery window.

deploy-bot: Release scheduled: private-onprem v1.5.0-rc4 -> deploy window 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary: 3 hosts for 60m. Rollback toggle enabled. (runbook attached)

Tom Li: Uploading checksums now, will paste sha256 + cosign sig shortly.

Dena Patel: Heads up — private console includes a DB migration (20260401_add_feature_flags.sql). Can someone run an offline dry-run against the snapshot before canary?

Akshay Rao: I ran the migration against the latest snapshot in staging, looks fine. No destructive ops on user tables. Verified image pinning as well: registry.redwood.local/nginx:1.23@sha256:abcdef1234567890... (truncated)

Maria Gomez: Cosign key is customer-kms-protected (kms://projects/rdw/keys/private-release). Tom, can you attach the cosign verify command + uploaded sig object?

Tom Li: Sure — signature uploaded to s3://redwood-private-releases/v1.5.0-rc4/signature.sig

Tom Li: ```
cosign verify-blob --key kms://projects/rdw/keys/private-release --signature signature.sig installer.tar.gz
```

jen: Release notes draft: https://drive.redwood/internal/releases/v1.5.0-rc4-notes.md — added note about quantization flag changes and onprem installer now supporting rm-propagation. Please review; customer-facing blurb needed.

Akshay Rao: :thumbsup: from infra. Rollback plan: if we need to revert, we'll flip the image pin to v1.5.0-rc3 digests and restart the private-controller reconcile. I'll prepare the rollback recipe and toggle flag: private_onprem.rollback=true.

Dena Patel: Can we shorten the canary to 30m? Support is stretched that night and they'd prefer a quicker canary to reduce blast radius.

Maria Gomez: We can shorten to 30m and start canary +30m. @deploy-bot can you update the window?

deploy-bot: Window updated: 2026-04-02 02:30-04:30 UTC. Canary: 3 hosts for 30m. Rollback flag: private_onprem.rollback=true. Ops notified.

sre-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. If rollback is needed ping me and I'll run lib/rollback.sh and coordinate DB downtime.

Tom Li: Final artifacts posted:
- s3://redwood-private-releases/v1.5.0-rc4/installer.tar.gz
- s3://redwood-private-releases/v1.5.0-rc4/signature.sig
- s3://redwood-private-releases/v1.5.0-rc4/images-sha256.txt (contains all pinned digests and checksums)
sha256(installer.tar.gz)= e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855

Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone. I'm merging the release branch now and will kick the distro job once the window opens. Will post a short post-deploy summary in this thread. :rocket:
